title: Early Morning Sunwatch
text:
🌅 Early Morning Sunwatch — October 30, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.1)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B6.4 (Peaked October 28, 2026 at 12:52 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 332 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.33)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

We're looking pretty quiet right now. 💛

A broad dark coronal region and several bright active areas are visible, while overall solar conditions remain quiet.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 94 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
